remarks: Welcome to this exquisite 5-bedroom, 3.5-bathroom home, nestled on a sought-after street in Darien with picturesque views of the pond and a charming fountain. This property provides a tranquil retreat right in your backyard. Step inside to discover a new, expansive kitchen designed for both functionality and style. With sleek white quartz countertops, state-of-the-art appliances, and ample storage, it provides an inviting space for both everyday meals and entertaining guests. The kitchen flows into a cozy family room with an inviting fireplace. The great room is ideal for large family gatherings, complete with a wet bar, wine cooler, and lovely cabinetry. All 5 bedrooms are upstairs, the primary suite with a luxury bathroom overlooking the pond. Walk down the hallway to a large bedroom with an en-suite bathroom and a private balcony with views of the pond, and don't miss the 3 other large bedrooms on this level. The finished attic adds versatility, whether you envision it as a playroom, office, or gym. This home is a true gem....don't miss this great opportunity to make this your forever home!
